inspiration.source_location: acid.sql: standard-cast checks around test016 and test019
inspiration.observed_pattern: Public SQL conformance checks use CAST to convert NULL and textual numeric values into explicitly typed numeric results, including DECIMAL precision.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored settlement ledger. Grouped decimal amounts are cast to two-place DECIMAL totals, textual tax units are cast before aggregation, and NULL-only settlements are classified separately. The schema, rows, expressions, aliases, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Account 501 sums two positive amounts and textual tax units; account 502 has a negative amount that rounds to -5.00 and a positive tax unit; account 503 has only NULL inputs and must retain NULL aggregate casts with an empty classification.
determinism_notes: Entry IDs, account IDs, decimal literals, and text amounts are fixed; the grouped output is ordered by the unique account ID with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE settlement_entries (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,3) NULL, tax_units_text VARCHAR(16) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT account_id, CAST(SUM(amount) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS total_amount, CAST(SUM(CAST(tax_units_text AS DECIMAL(10,3))) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS total_tax_units, CASE WHEN CAST(SUM(amount) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NULL THEN 'empty' WHEN CAST(SUM(amount) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 0 THEN 'credit' ELSE 'debit' END AS settlement_class FROM settlement_entries GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY account_id
